_notice: Fictional judge demo personas for the HaqSetu AI hackathon prototype. These people do not exist; they are for demonstration only and carry no real eligibility.

personas.name: Lakshmi Gowda (fictional)
personas.description: I'm 18 and live in a village near Mysuru in Karnataka with my parents and two brothers. My father works on a small farm and we earn about 1.2 lakh rupees a year. I just finished my 12th standard and want to continue to college, but fees are hard for us. I belong to a Scheduled Caste family and we have a BPL ration card.

personas.name: Savitha Rao (fictional)
personas.description: I am 65 years old and live alone in an apartment in Bengaluru. My husband passed away three years ago and I have no regular job. I get a small income of about 1.5 lakh rupees a year from rent and help from my son. I hold a BPL card and I am a homemaker, and I am looking for a monthly pension I can rely on.

personas.name: Arjun Naik (fictional)
personas.description: I am 24 and I use a wheelchair because of a polio-related disability. I have a graduate degree and run a small phone-repair shop in Mangaluru, which makes me self-employed. My shop earns me around 4.8 lakh rupees a year. I am male and I do not have a BPL card, and I want to know what support I can get for my work and health.
